meta.name: top-design
meta.description: Create award-winning, immersive web experiences at the level of Awwwards-featured agencies. Use when the user mentions "Awwwards quality", "make my site stunning", "scroll animations", "parallax storytelling", "cinematic web design", "portfolio site", or "brand experience". Also trigger when elevating a standard landing page into a memorable digital experience. Covers dramatic typography, purposeful motion, scroll-based composition, and performance-optimized animation. For foundational UI, see refactoring-ui. For type selection, see web-typography.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造获奖级沉浸式网页体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让网站拥有电影级滚动动画和视觉冲击力
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want cinematic scroll animations and stunning visual impact

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像顶尖数字设计机构一样，帮你打造沉浸式网页体验。它会从排版、动效、滚动叙事等维度评分，并给出具体改进建议，目标是达到 Awwwards 获奖水准。
howto.when: 当你提到“Awwwards 质量”、“滚动动画”、“视差叙事”、“电影级网页设计”、“作品集网站”或“品牌体验”等关键词时触发。也适用于将普通落地页提升为令人难忘的数字体验。

say.text: 帮我设计一个作品集网站，要有滚动动画和视差效果。
say.note: Claude 会从排版、动效等维度评分并给出改进建议。

say.text: 这个落地页怎么改才能达到 Awwwards 获奖水平？
say.note: Claude 会按评分标准逐项分析并给出具体优化方案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude behaves like a top digital design agency, helping you create immersive web experiences. It scores your design across typography, motion, scroll narrative, etc., and gives specific improvements to reach Awwwards-winning quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Awwwards quality", "scroll animations", "parallax storytelling", "cinematic web design", "portfolio site", or "brand experience". Also when elevating a standard landing page into a memorable digital experience.

say_en.text: Design a portfolio site with scroll animations and parallax effects.
say_en.note: Claude will score and suggest improvements across typography, motion, etc.

say_en.text: How can I improve this landing page to Awwwards-winning level?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze each rubric category and give specific optimizations.
